Gaslands

Gaslands is a post-apocalyptic vehicular combat game that uses modified Hot Wheels and Matchbox cars as miniatures. At 1:56 scale, these die-cast cars are compatible with 28mm infantry, making it easy to add foot soldiers, terrain, and custom 3D printed accessories.

What scale am I actually printing?

Miniature Scale

1:56
Measurement
vehicle scale
Eye Level Height
N/A

Gaslands vehicles are 1:56 scale die-cast cars — the same ratio as 28mm infantry. This natural compatibility means 3D printed weapon mounts, armor plates, and terrain pieces designed for 28mm work perfectly. The game uses template-based movement rather than measuring tape.

Publisher: Osprey Games·Base Sizes: N/A (uses die-cast car bases)

Printing these minis on FDM

Gaslands is a 3D printing playground — weapon mounts, roll cages, spike strips, and terrain scatter all print beautifully. Use 0.2mm nozzle at 0.06mm layers for weapon details. Print accessories in resin for durability, terrain in FDM for speed. The game encourages creative kitbashing over precision painting.

All settings tested on my Bambu Lab A1 Mini with PLA. Your printer may want something different — always print a test piece first.

Frequently Asked Questions

What scale is Gaslands?
Gaslands miniatures are 1:56 scale (1:56 ratio), measured vehicle scale. Gaslands vehicles are 1:56 scale die-cast cars — the same ratio as 28mm infantry. This natural compatibility means 3D printed weapon mounts, armor plates, and terrain pieces designed for 28mm work perfectly. The game uses template-based movement rather than measuring tape.
What base sizes does Gaslands use?
Gaslands uses the following base sizes: N/A (uses die-cast car bases).
